compatibility.coverage: Ordered decision rules apply to all source×target pairs; renderer-family agnostic customFilter

rules.when: source/target is VQuery or ordinary non-chart Picture/decoration
rules.feedback: 当前仅支持图表过滤条件，查询组件复制粘贴在后续任务处理。

rules.when: plugin flag true, missing registered render/type, or filter capability unknown/absent
rules.feedback: 该图表尚未确认支持过滤条件复制粘贴，请使用已支持图表。
rules.note: 当前49内建类未发现axis无filter；未来/插件仍需运行能力核验，不默认允许。

rules.when: source.tableId or target.tableId missing, or not exactly equal by existing ID representation
rules.feedback: 仅支持同一数据集的图表；请切换为相同数据集。

rules.when: leaf fieldId not in target resolved dataset/chart field catalog, sentinel count/-1, deleted field, deType changed, source chart-only calculated field unavailable
rules.feedback: 目标图表缺少过滤字段或字段类型不兼容；未粘贴任何条件。
rules.note: 不能按字段显示名匹配、静默删条件或仅检验目标axis已选字段。需要目标真实可选字段目录及source deType。

rules.when: unsupported dynamicDate/sysParams/calendar/empty group/unknown key or unvalidated complex structure
rules.feedback: 包含当前版本暂不支持的过滤条件结构；请使用基本固定条件。
rules.note: 明确后续Session接复杂形态；不能抹dynamicTimeSetting后当基本条件成功。嵌套分组仅当实际UI样本及组件测试已覆盖才放行。

rules.when: development same-page same-editor session, known built-ins, sameDataset, all fields compatible, actual serializer basic shape accepted, permission stub allow
rules.feedback: 完整复制/替换全部过滤条件，包括现有两个条件与root logic；不对图表type pair设置bar-line白名单。
rules.coverage: 49x49=2401个内建source×target静态组合受同一规则约束；不是2401个运行用例通过。

rules.when: permission stub deny/unknown, clipboard empty/expired, editor session changed or target paste busy/changed
rules.feedback: 说明无可用条件、会话失效、无权限或目标正在处理；保持原条件与原数据。

root.logic: and|or; RowAuth.init defaults or only if absent/falsy
root.items: ordered full array; keep all two conditions and grouping

serializer.metadata_requirement: FieldTree.init rehydrates field by fieldId, RowAuth.dfsInit gets name/deType from field. Copy compatibility metadata must be separate from canonical customFilter; do not persist source field objects.
serializer.undefined_and_missing: dfsInit destructuring can create own keys with undefined. dfsSubmit retains those own keys; JS cloneDeep preserves undefined, while actual JSON.stringify/request/save omits undefined object keys. null/empty string/[]/{} are distinct; compare own-property presence before transport and exact JSON boundary after transport separately. Do not normalize all missing keys to empty values.
serializer.time_value: timeValue is produced by getTimeValue(dynamicTimeSetting); default {} can yield undefined even for fixed non-date leaf. Do not assume it always equals empty string.
serializer.supported_basic_candidate: actual same-dataset text enum/logic and numeric logic plus fixed-date only once captured/validated; operators selected by actual FilterFiled textOptions/dateOptions/valueOptions. No invented universal operator or forced all-leaves schema.
serializer.validation_side_effects: FilterTree emits filter-data then snapshotStore.recordSnapshotCache(changeFilter), closes dialog; Editor changeFilterData only clone assigns tree. UI paste must preserve existing refresh/snapshot sequence deliberately and verify query count.

existing_two_condition_sample.authority: 用户已有的两个实际条件，不能用一个树样本代替
capture_steps: 打开源图表现有FilterTree，记录两个条件实际字段/操作符/值/分组/root logic；不改成示意条件
捕获RowAuth save、FilterTree filter-data、Editor view.customFilter完整对象及own-key/undefined清单
捕获真实/chartData/getData payload与/dataVisualization/updateCanvas或saveCanvas的canvasViewInfo对应树
重开资源，经findById恢复后再次捕获完整tree、两个叶节点、查询结果与画面；不以截图单独证明树保真
existing_two_condition_sample.expected_comparison: two leaves preserved, root/group logic and term/value/enumValue/fieldId unchanged; request/save JSON serialization compared at its real boundary
existing_two_condition_sample.fixture_promotion: 只有真实UI输出捕获、来源/字节绑定后可作golden；本清单不提供伪造golden。

editor_integration_candidate.existing_entry: 结果过滤 block next to existing openTreeFilter/removeItems; shared non-plugin branch rather than canvas global menu or line render helper
editor_integration_candidate.selection: current view.render/view.type resolved via chartViewManager; use this inventory per-type evidence and field-catalog result; do not gate only library G2 or chart.type line
editor_integration_candidate.copy: clone the exact current canonical view.customFilter; include whole tree/two conditions. Keep compatibility metadata (dataset ID, source field deType, current editing session) separate; memory only.
editor_integration_candidate.paste: validate whole payload and every target field first; explicit allow/deny/unknown development permission seam; perform candidate real query before adopting conditions, only one operation per current target; failure retains original; reuse real renderer and save chain without generic lifecycle refactor.
editor_integration_candidate.refresh: changeFilterData is local assignment; FilterTree changeFilter records changeFilter snapshot. UI lane must route through existing refresh signal and verify actual query count, not merely invoke assignment.
editor_integration_candidate.no_filter_feedback: unsupported/unknown registered capability gives explicit disabled or refusal feedback with reason; no silent empty success

query_save_chain.shared_filter_meaning: calcData obtains handler by render/type (default fallback exists), resolves dataset/permissions, consumes view.customFilter via ChartFilterTreeService and CustomWhere2Str before SQL; frontend library selection happens in views/index by chart library. No basic filter transport branch limited to line.
query_save_chain.dataset_permission: backend dataset READ remains real in source; development test permission seam is not real authorization acceptance and must not silently bypass backend production checks.

single_chart_test_endpoint.limit: /chart/save comment says single chart save test; cannot substitute dashboard saveCanvas/updateCanvas+findById acceptance
